t: You're on Leman Street, in Tower Hamlets. It was once known as Lemon Street, and it was laid out in the seventeenth century as part of the development of Goodman's Fields. That development also gave us Ayliff Street, Mansell Street and Prescot Street. The street is named after John Leman, who lived from 1544 to 1632 and was responsible for the development. He was a tradesman from Beccles who went on to become Lord Mayor of London.
